title: Find Quiet Students
prompt: Find students who took at least one exam but never scored the highest or lowest score in any exam. Return student_id and student_name.
expected_query: WITH exam_bounds AS (SELECT exam_id, MIN(score) AS min_score, MAX(score) AS max_score FROM exams GROUP BY exam_id), noisy_students AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.student_id FROM exams e INNER JOIN exam_bounds b ON e.exam_id = b.exam_id WHERE e.score = b.min_score OR e.score = b.max_score) SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name FROM students s WHERE s.student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM exams) AND s.student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM noisy_students);
explanation: Quiet students have exam rows, but their ID never appears among per-exam min or max scorers.
hints: Find students whose score equals either boundary.
Exclude those students from participating students.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to require at least one exam.
Comparing against global min/max instead of per-exam min/max.
Returning students who never took any exam.
